title: gate fix-round status rejects --feature while start and end require it
detail: Seen 2026-11-11 by a regression-sentinel in the capture-refuses-zero-count sprint: its role file tells it to check fix-round status, it passed --feature as start and end require, argparse rejected it, and it did not retry. status should accept --feature (and may ignore it) so the three subcommands take the same arguments.
